title: Fuobe Restore · archive footage restored and colourised
description: Runs Video tools → Restore & colourise (POST /api/restore) on your own archive clip in local/restore/: scan.mp4 (10–60 s of black-and-white or faded footage you own or that is in the public domain). On ComfyUI, LTX-2.5 22B distilled with Lightricks' Restore IC-LoRA, 960x544 tiles fused every step, 97-frame windows each starting from the last 17 restored frames, the sound put back; Restore to 4K adds the Detail Refine IC-LoRA at twice the canvas. On fal, LTX-2.3 22B reference video to video with the same LoRA (mirrored from Hugging Face with your token), one untiled pass a piece. The LoRA is gated: accept its licence on Hugging Face and add a token in Settings → LoRAs before an open or cloud run. Temporal drift is read against the scan; nothing here has been rendered yet.
